name: Product development
description: From mood board or sketch to an approved sample. Pattern making, grading to your own size chart, fabric and trim sourcing, proto, fit and salesman samples — an ODM apparel manufacturer for design teams who want the collection pushed forward.

name: Jersey & fleece
description: French terry, loopback and brushed fleece, cotton jersey and rib. Sweatshirts, hoodies, lounge shorts and tees — a custom t-shirt factory Vietnam labels use for seasonal drops and core programmes alike.

name: Woven fashion
description: Dresses, blouses, shirting, skirts and trousers in poplin, linen blends, viscose and twill. A woven pants supplier Vietnam teams use for both boutique and department-store collections.

name: Knit dresses & womenswear
description: Jersey and rib dresses, tops and co-ords. Fit blocks are kept on file, so a re-order or a new colourway lands on grade — knit dress manufacturer for European and US labels.

name: Kidswear
description: Full range for 2–14 years, produced to EN 14682 and CPSIA drawstring requirements. Soft cottons, safe trims, pull-tested snaps.

name: Capsules & small runs
description: 500 pieces per style, split across colours from 200 each, so a new silhouette can be tested in store before it is scaled. The same lines and QA as a full programme.
